snippet.title: MEL-PRACTICE - Student Project
snippet.description:
MEL-PRACTICE is a point and click adventure game where you must find a way to kill yourself within a dream in order to escape. Only thing that can properly end you in this world is one particular individual, who you must track down throughout the whole game via talking to and helping others within the dream world. Explore wacky worlds, talk to... interesting characters, play minigames, and take in the vibes!

This game was made as part of a 8 month project for my college animation class. It was meant to release as a full game but I got too ambitious during its conception. So now, you just get a demo! However there is a very good chance that I don't work on this project anymore afterwards from losing interest in it over the project's duration. Though I may return to this project at some point or in some alternative way. I did take the time after the project ended though to touch up anything I wanted to either look better or weirder.

Link to the game: https://lua-computa.itch.io/mel-practice
